vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #1800 — triage:queue honors triageScopeIgnores

narratives.Description: `plan.policy.triageScopeIgnores[]` suppresses issues in the drift detector but not in `task triage:queue`. Operators who add ignore entries still see those issues ranked as actionable untriaged work.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Reuse `resolveScopeIgnores` from `packages/core/src/triage/scope-drift/scope-rules.ts` (or shared scope resolver) inside queue build path — filter cached issues in `packages/core/src/triage/queue/build-queue.ts` or `cache.ts` before ranking.
2. Add regression test in `packages/core/src/triage/queue/queue.test.ts` with a PROJECT-DEFINITION ignore label and assert the issue is excluded from queue output.
3. Run `pnpm -w exec vitest run packages/core/src/triage/queue/queue.test.ts` as verification evidence; CHANGELOG entry. Closes #1800.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator who ignored a held-open tracker via triageScopeIgnores, I want `task triage:queue` to exclude that issue, so that 'what's next' matches my stated intent.
narratives.Overview: See issue #1800 — drift detector honors ignores; queue does not.

narrative.Acceptance: Given an open cached issue matching a triageScopeIgnores label entry, when `task triage:queue` runs, then that issue number does not appear in the ranked output.
Given a unit test in queue.test.ts with ignore policy configured, when buildQueue/loadCachedIssues runs, then ignored issues are filtered consistently with scope-drift.
Given the fix lands, when CHANGELOG [Unreleased] is read, then it documents triage:queue honoring triageScopeIgnores. Closes #1800.
